claims.claim_text: Springs of Revolution supports grounding advocacy for Palestinian liberation in the grassroots positions of the Palestinian struggle.

Springs of Revolution's Palestinian Self-Determination amendment proposes framing DSA's commitment to a single Palestinian state within al-Thawabit, the Palestinian red lines adopted by the Palestinian National Council in 1977.
Springs of Revolution's Palestinian Self-Determination amendment proposes clarifying that support for a Palestinian state follows from commitment to Palestinian self-determination.
Springs of Revolution's R42-A01 amendment proposes increasing the Labor for an Arms Embargo campaign's emphasis on workers organizing international solidarity bodies within their unions.
Springs of Revolution's R42-A01 amendment proposes increasing the Labor for an Arms Embargo campaign's emphasis on workers becoming strike-ready to directly stop arms flows.
Springs of Revolution's R42-A01 amendment proposes removing a mandate to run congressional candidates in the next two years.
